zh: 优化侧边栏会话空间归类逻辑，内部临时与默认工作区不再暴露为空间文件夹，无自选工作区的对话一律以普通对话收拢在任务栏中。
完善数据库目录注册表，补充桌面宠物额度明细表的中英文元数据，通过全量自动化测试校验。
全面对齐移动端（iOS 与 Android）版本号与桌面端/Web端（v1.0.x），实现全端版本完全统一。
en: Refine sidebar conversation spaces grouping so internal scratch workspaces are never exposed as folders and plain chats remain neatly under tasks.
Complete db explorer catalog definitions with bilingual metadata for desktop pet quota details to pass all automated test suites.
Unify mobile (iOS and Android) versioning with desktop and web releases (v1.0.x) for total cross-platform consistency.
